questions.stem: 把 “We clean the classroom every day.” 改成被动语态。

options.text: The classroom is cleaned every day.
The classroom cleans every day.
The classroom is clean every day.
options.distractor: 这里 clean 是形容词，不是被动

options.text: We are cleaned the classroom every day.
options.distractor: 被提前的应是宾语 the classroom

questions.explanation: 宾语提前 + is cleaned，一般现在时保持不变。

questions.stem: 把 “Someone broke the window last night.” 改成被动语态。

options.text: The window was broken last night.
The window broke last night.
The window was broke last night.
options.distractor: be 后要接过去分词 broken

options.text: Someone was broken the window.

questions.explanation: 过去时被动：The window was broken（by someone 可省略）。

questions.stem: 把 “They are building a new hospital.” 改成被动语态。

options.text: A new hospital is being built.
A new hospital is built.
options.distractor: 原句是进行时，被动要保留进行

options.text: A new hospital is building.
options.distractor: 被动不能用 -ing 代替 be + done

options.text: A new hospital was built.

questions.stem: 把 “You must finish the work today.” 改成被动语态。

options.text: The work must finish today.
The work must be finished today.
The work must is finished today.
options.distractor: 情态动词后不能接 is

options.text: The work must finished today.

questions.explanation: 情态动词被动：must be finished。

questions.stem: 把 “He gave me a book.” 改成以 a book 为主语的被动语态。

options.text: A book was given to me by him.
A book was gave to me by him.
options.distractor: be 后要用过去分词 given

options.text: I was given a book by him.
options.distractor: 这里要求以 a book 为主语

options.text: A book gave to me by him.

questions.explanation: 双宾语变被动，以物作主语时要保留 to：was given to me。

questions.stem: 把 “We should take care of the old people.” 改成被动语态。

options.text: The old people should take care of.
options.distractor: 被动缺少 be，且短语动词的介词不能丢

options.text: The old people should be taken care of.
The old people should be taken care.
options.distractor: 短语动词变被动要保留 of

options.text: The old people should been taken care of.
options.distractor: 情态动词后要接 be 原形

questions.explanation: 短语动词 take care of 变被动时 of 必须保留：should be taken care of。
